output.summary: The repayment rider requires full $40,000 gross bonus repayment within 15 days of voluntary resignation at any time within 24 months, with no proration. The user's goal requires repayment obligation to expire by Month 12 (or prorate monthly on net after-tax payout) to avoid out-of-pocket clawback at Month 18. The rider's unprorated 24-month window directly violates the Month 12 expiration constraint, creating a Month 18 repayment obligation that would trigger out-of-pocket cash clawback.
